one_line: 13th‑century Yadava minister and scholar of dharmashastra and Ayurveda at Devagiri and Paithan.

appearance.age_look: early 40s, slim scholar’s build, upright posture
appearance.face: oval face, medium wheatish Deccan complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed black moustache, small tilak on the forehead, calm focused eyes with a thoughtful default expression
appearance.hair: straight black hair parted in the middle, pulled back into a short, tidy knot at the back of the head, mostly hidden under a simple off‑white cotton turban wrapped low and flat around the crown with one thin end tail resting over the left shoulder
appearance.costume: a knee‑length off‑white cotton angarkha-style tunic with side tie, long sleeves and a modest round neck, worn over a plain light‑cream dhoti wrapped in the Deccan style to the ankles with a neatly pleated front; a soft turmeric‑yellow cotton shawl draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back; simple brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery: a small copper neck amulet on a black thread and a thin copper bangle on the right wrist; fabrics are plain-woven with very subtle narrow borders in muted maroon at the edges of the shawl and dhoti.
appearance.signature: a rolled palm‑leaf manuscript bundle tied with a maroon cord in his left hand, and a single stylus tucked behind his right ear as a secondary detail

ref_desc: Hemadri Pandit is a wheatish-complexioned, turbaned Deccan scholar with an off-white angarkha, cream dhoti, turmeric-yellow shawl, simple copper ornaments, carrying a tied palm-leaf manuscript bundle and stylus, in a palette of off-white, cream, yellow, maroon and brown.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of Hemadri Pandit as a 13th-century Yadava minister-scholar from Devagiri: an early-40s, slim man with an oval wheatish Deccan face, sharp nose, small tilak, calm focused eyes and a neatly trimmed black moustache. His straight black hair is parted and pulled into a short knot, mostly hidden beneath a simple off-white cotton turban wrapped low and flat around the crown with one thin tail end hanging over the left shoulder. He wears an off-white knee-length angarkha-style tunic with long sleeves and side tie over a light-cream dhoti wrapped to the ankles in Deccan style, pleated at the front, all plain woven with subtle maroon borders. A turmeric-yellow cotton shawl is draped from the left shoulder across his chest and around his back, and he has brown leather sandals on his feet. For jewellery he has only a small copper amulet on a black thread at his neck and a thin copper bangle on his right wrist. In his left hand he holds a tied bundle of palm-leaf manuscripts with a maroon cord, while a writing stylus is tucked behind his right ear, reinforcing his scholarly role. Show him front-facing, three-quarter and back views in one image, clearly presenting his face, turban, hair knot, tunic, dhoti drape, shawl, sandals, ornaments, and palm-leaf manuscript bundle in a harmonious palette of off-white, cream, turmeric yellow, maroon and brown.
